/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/transport/createServer.ts | head -100; cat src/types/messages.ts | head -110; cat src/types/sessionStore.ts | head -110; cat src/transport/ws/connectionHandler.ts | head -35; cat src/config.ts | grep -n -A20 'resume'"

for p in ['src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts','src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts']:
 s=open(p).read().replace(\"import {answeringOrchestrator} from './wsTestSupport.js';\", \"import {answeringOrchestrator, eventually, stopTrackedEngines, delegatingTo} from './wsTestSupport.js';\")
 start=s.index('const eventually = async'); end=s.index('\\n};',start)+3; s=s[:start]+s[end:]
 start=s.index('  for (const client of clients.splice(0)) client.terminate();'); end=s.index('\\n  }',start)+4; s=s[:start]+'  await stopTrackedEngines(clients, servers);'+s[end:]
 start=s.index('const delegatingTo = (inner:'); end=s.index('\\n});',start)+4; s=s[:start]+s[end:]
 if 'conversationList' in p:
  s=s.replace('answeringOrchestrator, eventually, stopTrackedEngines, delegatingTo','answeringOrchestrator, stopTrackedEngines, delegatingTo')
  s=s.replace(\"      if (frame.type === 'connected') {\\n        connected = frame;\\n        client.send(typeof outbound === 'string' ? outbound : JSON.stringify(outbound));\\n        client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1}));\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      if (frame.type === 'pong') {\\n        resolve();\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      frames.push(frame);\", \"      if (frame.type "'!== '"'connected') {\\n        frames.push(frame);\\n        resolve();\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      connected = frame;\\n      client.send(typeof outbound === 'string' ? outbound : JSON.stringify(outbound));\")
  s=s.replace(\"    orchestrator: answeringOrchestrator,\", \"    orchestrator: answeringOrchestrator,\\n    history: {enabled: true},\")

  s=s.replace(\"fields: expect.objectContaining({userId: 'u1', error: 'database offline'}),\", \"fields: expect.objectContaining({sessionId: expect.any(String)}),\")
 open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace('rejected: Array(9).fill(false),','rejected: [false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false],'); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/types/session.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace('export const ErrorCodes = {','export const ErrorCodes = {\\n  UNSUPPORTED: \\'UNSUPPORTED\\','); open(p,'w').write(s)
